optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration
professionalSummary: Experienced project manager with a proven track record of planning and executing supplier onboarding projects across multiple manufacturer customers, reducing onboarding time and maintaining rigorous milestone tracking.
experienceHighlights: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining a detailed milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) in the programme tracker.

Tracked integration milestones with three integration engineers, updating supplier status weekly, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review, and agreeing recovery dates with supplier contacts and engineers.
Reduced average supplier onboarding time from 46 days to 29 days across seventeen suppliers after introducing standard mapping templates, as recorded against the baseline of the first six suppliers.
Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations, ensuring sequencing decisions and go-live confirmations were documented.
Authored completion notes for each onboarded supplier, documenting open mapping limitations and hand-over points for the support team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Programme tracker export showing onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, and template introduction marker; one supplier completion note with tracker record identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience in planning onboarding projects, tracking milestones, reducing onboarding time, coordinating decisions, and documenting limitations. They do not provide evidence of production deployment, ownership beyond coordination, or any protected characteristic.
